name: Reactive Arthritis
definition: Sterile inflammatory arthritis arising after certain gastrointestinal or genitourinary infections, often with enthesitis and other spondyloarthritis features.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical with cause-directed infection testing.
investigations.MRI: MRI/ultrasound may assess sacroiliitis/enthesitis in persistent disease.

green: Treat active infection when still present/indicated
amber: Persistent arthritis may require DMARD therapy under specialist care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Ama/Shotha phenotype may be documented only alongside formal inflammatory/infectious assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Sterile inflammatory arthritis arising after certain gastrointestinal or genitourinary infections, often with enthesitis and other spondyloarthritis features.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
